findings.reason: the plan's record would be internally contradictory about which incident motivates §11's producer-reload fix, so the author would correct the role, as an earlier review's equivalent evidence-contradiction finding against §9 was answered.
findings.text: §11 closes its Why with "Run reviews were the role behind the 19:18Z reports-root deletion", but §10 attributes that 19:18:11Z deletion to a plan review, `r-20261016T190754696739-plan-review-of-a-shadow-cannot-see-its-primary`, and calls it "the plan-review worker"; the run id confirms the role, so §11 states a role its own cited incident does not support and a coordinator reading it would misjudge which producer-launched reflex carries the exposure

rubric_items.anchors_resolve: pass — `reckon/crew/obligation_snapshot.py`, `reckon/crew/follower_registration.py`, `reckon/_worker_fence.py`, `reckon/_backends.py`, `reckon/nested_launch.py` and `CLI_MODULE_FILES` all resolve, and the cited run id resolves to a live pointer.
rubric_items.done_when: pass — §11's done-when names a measurable assertion set plus a declared negative control ("the same test against a copy of the base tree fails on the first change, logged under the run directory"), and the reload path it leans on is exercised elsewhere (`tests/test_producer_survives_its_reload.py`).
rubric_items.evidence_paths: pass — the run directory a gate log lands in is durable (13,863 run directories under `~/.config/reckon/crew/runs/`, oldest 2026-08-12), and the cited producer-launched run's directory `r-20261016T220011535719-review-of-fence-reports-seal-population-at-merge-1a26b890fe14` is present.
rubric_items.naming: pass — the test name `tests/test_a_launch_code_change_reloads_the_producer.py` and the merged symbol name describe the mechanism; no plan label, stage name or ticket number reaches code.
rubric_items.reasoning: a finding — §11's mechanism and its measurement hold under all three checks (the stamp set really is `CLI_MODULE_FILES` + `reckon/crew/*.py`; the §10 merge 502b4f306 touched only `reckon/_worker_fence.py` and its test, so no stamped file moved and `f307320c…` genuinely equalled a fresh computation; the sealed-vs-unsealed argv difference between the producer's launch and a post-§10 CLI launch confirms the lever), but the paragraph's closing attribution contradicts §10's own account of the same incident.
rubric_items.single_goal: pass — §11 carries one deliverable: one stamp function over the package modules, used by both callers.
rubric_items.wiring: pass — the plan's declared relationships are unchanged by this wave, and §11's precedent sibling (§10, landed 502b4f306) is already `done` in the section declarations, so nothing §11 needs is outstanding.
